orn.definition: v. t. To ornament; to adorn.

ornament.translation:
n. 装饰, 点缀品, 教堂用品
vt. 装饰, 修饰

ornamental.definition: n. any plant grown for its beauty or ornamental value
ornamental.translation:
n. 装饰物, 观赏植物
a. 装饰性的, 装饰的, 观赏用的

ornamentalism.definition: n. the practice of ornamental display

ornamentally.translation: adv. 装饰地, 用作装饰品地

ornamentals.definition:
plural of ornamental
n. any plant grown for its beauty or ornamental value
ornamentals.translation:
(ornamental 的复数) n. 装饰物, 观赏植物
a. 装饰性的, 装饰的, 观赏用的

ornamentation.definition:
n. the state of being ornamented
n. the act of adding extraneous decorations to something
ornamentation.translation: n. 装饰, 装饰术, 装饰品, 修饰

ornamentations.definition:
plural of ornamentation
n. the state of being ornamented
n. the act of adding extraneous decorations to something
ornamentations.translation: (ornamentation 的复数) n. 装饰, 装饰术, 装饰品, 修饰

ornamented.definition:
v make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.
v be an ornament to
ornamented.translation:
a. 花式字体的
v. 装饰, 点缀, 美化( ornament的过去式和过去分词 )

ornamenter.definition: n. One who ornaments; a decorator.

ornamenting.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Ornament
ornamenting.translation: v. 装饰, 点缀, 美化( ornament的现在分词 )

ornaments.definition:
n something used to beautify
v make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.
v be an ornament to

ornate.definition: s marked by elaborate rhetoric and elaborated with decorative details
ornate.translation: a. 装饰的, 华丽的

ornately.translation: adv. 装饰过分地；词藻华丽地

ornateness.definition: n. The quality of being ornate.

orneriness.translation: n. 不合作；故意刁难（ornery的名词）

ornery.definition: s having a difficult and contrary disposition
ornery.translation: a. 下等的, 低劣的, 脾气坏的, 故意刁难的

ornidazole.translation: [化] 奥硝唑; 氯醇硝唑

ornis.translation: n. (某一时期, 地区或环境内的)鸟类, 鸟类志

ornithic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to birds; as, ornithic fossils.

ornithichnite.definition: n. The footmark of a bird occurring in strata of stone.

ornithine.definition: n an amino acid that does not occur in proteins but is important in the formation of urea

ornithine cycle.translation:
[化] 鸟氨酸循环
[医] 鸟氨酸循环

ornithine decarboxylase.translation:
[化] 鸟氨酸脱羧酶
[医] 鸟氨酸脱羧酶

n. 鸟臀目
[网络] 鸟龙类；鸟盘目；鸟龙目

ornithischian.definition: n herbivorous dinosaur with a pelvis like that of a bird

ornithischians.definition:
plural of ornithischian
n herbivorous dinosaur with a pelvis like that of a bird
ornithischians.translation: (ornithischian 的复数) [古生]n.鸟臀目恐龙

ornitho-.definition: A combining form fr. Gr. /, /, a bird.
ornitho-.translation: 表示“鸟”之义(在元音前作ornith-)

ornithobilharzia turkistanicum.translation: [医] 土耳其斯坦分体吸虫

ornithogalum.translation: [网络] 虎眼万年青属；天鹅绒；天鹅绒属

ornithogalum thyrsoides.translation: [网络] 虎眼万年青；好望角虎眼万年青

ornithogalum umbellatum.translation: [网络] 圣星百合；伞形虎眼万年青；伞花虎眼万年青

ornithological.definition: a. of or relating to ornithology

ornithologist.definition: n. a zoologist who studies birds

ornithologists.definition:
plural of ornithologist
n. a zoologist who studies birds
ornithologists.translation: (ornithologist 的复数) n. 鸟类学者

ornithology.definition: n. the branch of zoology that studies birds

ornithomancy.definition: n. Divination by means of birds, their flight, etc.
ornithomancy.translation: n. 鸟占术( 根据鸟的飞翔和鸣叫卜凶吉的占卜术)

ornithomimid.definition: n lightly built medium-sized dinosaur having extremely long limbs and necks with small heads and big brains and large eyes

ornithopoda.definition:
n. pl. An order of herbivorous dinosaurs with birdlike
   characteristics in the skeleton, esp. in the pelvis and hind legs,
   which in some genera had only three functional toes, and supported the
   body in walking as in Iguanodon. See Illust. in Appendix.

ornithopods.definition:
plural of ornithopod
n bipedal herbivorous dinosaur
ornithopods.translation: (ornithopod 的复数) n.[古生]鸟脚亚目恐龙

ornithopter.definition: n heavier-than-air craft that is propelled by the flapping of wings

ornithorhynchus.definition: n type genus of the family Ornithorhynchidae

ornithoscopy.definition: n. Observation of birds and their habits.
ornithoscopy.translation: n. 鸟类的观察研究；鸟飞翔(或鸣叫)占卜术

ornithosis.definition: n an atypical pneumonia caused by a rickettsia microorganism and transmitted to humans from infected birds
ornithosis.translation: n. 鸟疫,饲鸟病( 鸟类的一种病毒性疾病)

ornithotomy.definition: n. The anatomy or dissection of birds.

ornithuric acid.translation:
[化] 鸟尿酸; N,N'-二苯甲酰鸟氨酸
[医] 鸟尿酸, 二苯甲酰鸟氨酸

ornl.translation: abbr. Oak Ridge National Laboratory <美>国立橡树岭实验所
